{{Otheruses|Imperial Palace}}
The '''Irmenu imperial palace''' was the [[Palace|palatial residence]] of the [[Emperor/Legends|emperors]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Irmenu]]. [[Standard century/Legends|Centuries]] before the [[Declaration of a New Order]], the palace was destroyed when Irmenu's aristocracy rose up and overthrew the tyrannical rule of the emperors. The ruins of the palace remained as late as [[11 ABY/Legends|11 ABY]].
